rootCauseGroups.root: Unknown-typed errors used as JSX left operands; error && element can return unknown, not ReactNode.
rootCauseGroups.fix: Use Boolean(error) && existing JSX, or a truthy ternary yielding JSX/null. Keep unknown error payload passed unchanged to QueryError. Preserve existing truthiness rather than switching to a null-only predicate.
rootCauseGroups.sharedChange: None: unknown is correct at an error boundary.

rootCauseGroups.root: Top-level TOptions.count is numeric plural selection, not an arbitrary formatted interpolation slot.
rootCauseGroups.fix: For existing {{count}} captions, pass the formatted or missing display through replace: { count: displayValue, ...allOtherInterpolationVariables }. Only use top-level count for a known numeric plural operand, never a dash, formatted string, null or invented zero. Existing catalogs and placeholders stay unchanged. Feature flags can narrow the local numeric count or derive flags.filter(...).length inside the flags-present branch.
rootCauseGroups.additionalLatentDiagnostic: SafetyHistoryWidget's missing stats.priorCount currently masks a number|string count option; repair that interpolation in the same one-file assignment.
rootCauseGroups.sharedChange: None: use existing i18next options; no wrapper, catalog rename or TFunction relaxation.

rootCauseGroups.root: Specialist display.formatter requires both value and unit; callers only return value.
rootCauseGroups.fix: Retain existing formatter output in value and explicitly return unit: '' where that output already contains its currency, percent, byte or duration unit; counts are dimensionless. Do not guess, append or duplicate a unit. Do not change formatter validation or raw numeric input.
rootCauseGroups.sharedChange: None: mandatory explicit unit prevents ambiguous/doubled accessible output.

rootCauseGroups.root: useTelemetry history now exposes SignalHistoryPoint {ts, kind, value, provenance metadata}; consumers still expect legacy valueNum/timestamp or a numeric-analysis structural shape excluding booleans.
rootCauseGroups.fix: Adapt at each feature's algorithm boundary, without mutating hook/cache/wire values. Dashcam maps ts to timestamp and discriminates value into number/string/boolean slots preserving false and zero. Root-cause supplies ts and a numeric/string/null analysis value; boolean samples remain present with a nonnumeric null analysis operand, not 0/1. Raw evidence/provenance remains in evidenceBundle. Sparkline reads canonical value and accepts finite numbers only, retaining the existing trend/order semantics. Do not silently introduce timestamp deduplication or boolean promotion.
rootCauseGroups.existingOwnerDecision: signalHistorySamples is an existing kind-aware numeric extraction owner, but it sorts/deduplicates and is feature-owned; it is not a drop-in for this widget's current order-based trend. Existing SignalQueryControls adapters were located but importing a UI root module into feature hooks is not a new shared algorithm API. No new adapter is necessary for three distinct consumption contracts.
rootCauseGroups.sharedChange: None: do not add legacy fields to SignalHistoryPoint or broaden numeric analysis to coerce booleans.

rootCauseGroups.root: DashboardSourceBrief requires full DataState, whereas combineDataStates returns a trust-only Pick. EvidenceSourceNotice owns per-source trust, not analysis summary/limitations.
rootCauseGroups.fix: Reuse the full correctly assembled caller-owned shellProps.dataState for the drivetrain brief. Remove only duplicated unsupported summary/limitations props from EvidenceSourceNotice callers; preserve those exact values on DiagnosticEvidenceBrief and the existing analysis/export sections. SourceContent correctly uses its SourceState, ReactNode overrides and recovery props; it needs no relaxation.
rootCauseGroups.sharedChange: None: do not weaken DataState or add dead summary/limitations props to EvidenceSourceNotice.

rootCauseGroups.root: DataStatus has no offline member. Offline/paused refresh is represented by isRefreshBlocked, separately from retained-data stale status.
rootCauseGroups.fix: Use isRefreshBlocked for offline/paused wording and warning tone. Choose initial-loading first, then blocked refresh, then stale, then healthy fallback so blocked retained data is not mislabeled healthy or masked by stale. Preserve StaleRefreshWarning, retained payloads and retries; a paused refresh is not independent proof of network disconnection.
rootCauseGroups.sharedChange: None: do not add offline to DataStatus or cast status to string.

rootCauseGroups.root: Missing icon bindings resolve to undefined names or browser History; unused local bindings/imports are strict compiler failures; priorCount is calculated but omitted from stats and incorrectly destructured by CompactView.
rootCauseGroups.fix: Restore local icon bindings from the file's existing registry/library, remove only unused imports/declarations, and expose the already-computed priorCount in stats. Do not remove UI or invent new API fields.
